title: Luxuriant Indian Lentil Curry
description: A rich and indulgent Udupi dish featuring tender lentils in a flavorful, umami curry sauce with a glassy-jelly texture, made with a pasta-water emulsion and kosher-friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large pot, bring 4 cups of water to a boil and add the lentils, cooking until they are tender.
In a blender or food processor, combine the onion, garlic, and ginger and blend until smooth.
In a large pan, heat the oil over medium heat and add the blended onion mixture, cooking until fragrant.
Add the curry powder, turmeric, and cumin to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked lentils, pasta water, and salt to the pan and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have melded together.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce to a smooth, glassy-jelly texture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs or a dollop of raita if desired.
